title: How do we decide if El Niño conditions are present?
author: NOAA Climate.gov; drawing by Glen Becker and Fiona Martin
license_observation: No image-specific reuse license was observed. Attribution is printed on the source. The archived official Climate.gov host supplied the same linked asset after the public page was blocked.
figure: Complete diagnostic flowchart; single GIF frame, frame 0 of 1.
object_count_basis: Three question boxes, four yes/no diamonds, two atmospheric-evidence circles, two terminal outcomes.
reading_path: Start at the upper-left ocean-temperature question and descend diagonally through persistence and atmospheric tests. Rejection branches collect on the left; positive evidence ends at lower right.
merit: Charcoal question boxes anchor a readable diagonal stair. Pale red and gray decision marks carry meaning without overpowering the white page; rounded explanation circles distinguish evidence from questions.
preview_note: GIF is not animated: exactly one frame; preview is frame 0 at the original 2500×1693 resolution.
